name: Aranea Major
backstory: Aranea Major is a spider summoned via a Beast Master's ability, a variant of . Aranea Major is upgraded from Aranea once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes Aranea Aculeata once the Beast Master reaches level 11.
